goal.text: The project coordinator gets a repair queue each Saturday afternoon, so nobody is promised a bike back before the work can be done.
cites: [A:A01 "so nobody is promised a bike back before the work can be done"]

agent_checkable.metric: Promised dates earlier than the queue's bench time allows
agent_checkable.check: A script adds up bench minutes in queue order and compares each promised date (Q01).
cites: [A:A01 "Q01 a promised date is never earlier than the queue's bench time allows (blocker)."]

agent_checkable.metric: Brake or steering jobs behind another kind of job
agent_checkable.check: A script checks the queue order (Q02).

outcome.metric: Bikes promised back earlier than the work allows
cites: [A:A01 "No bike promised back earlier than the work allows, over a term."]

outcome.metric: Steering jobs done the same Saturday
cites: [A:A01 "Every steering job is done the same Saturday."]

users_and_stakeholders.interest: Work through the queue in order.
cites: [A:A01 "Repair volunteers (users: work through the queue in order)."]

users_and_stakeholders.interest: Signs off the queue each Saturday afternoon.
cites: [A:A01 "Project coordinator (approver: signs off the queue each Saturday afternoon)."]

users_and_stakeholders.interest: Their bike back on the date they were given.

steps: The coordinator sorts the slips by hand.
The coordinator estimates each job from memory.
The coordinator writes the queue on a whiteboard.
problems: Estimates from memory are often an hour out.
A bike with a loose headset waited two weekends.
cites: [A:A01 "estimates from memory are often an hour out"]
[A:A01 "Out: buying parts, bike donations, the Tuesday youth session."]

inputs.description: Typed drop-off forms, about 25 each Saturday.
inputs.format: plain text, one form per ticket
constraints: The customer's description of the fault
cites: [S:S01 §whole file]

glossary.meaning: The standard time a job takes, from the bench-time table.
cites: [A:A01 "Bench minutes: the standard time a job takes, from the bench-time table."]

glossary.meaning: The bearings that let the handlebars turn.
The drop-off form a customer fills in.

acceptance_tests.words: I give it four made-up Saturdays of slips, and every brake or steering job is at the top of the queue.
cites: [A:A01 "I give it four made-up Saturdays of slips, and every brake or steering job is at the top of the queue."]

context_inventory.evidence_for: bench minutes and the bench minutes open each Saturday

ranks.what: Reference documents in the context pack
Official documentation on the maker's own site

confidence.high: The row quotes the form and the bench-time table line that decided it.
confidence.medium: A reputable secondary source; not expected here.
confidence.low: Inferred or one weak source; such a row is marked 'ask the workshop' and raised as a question.

conflicts: The higher rank wins within its own area.
A conflict the ranks do not settle is reported with both citations, never decided silently.

output.description: A repair queue, one row per drop-off form, in working order. A slip with no fault description is refused as 'ask the customer'.
output.format: Table, one row per ticket, in queue order

fields.name: ticket
fields.description: The ticket number from the form.

fields.name: bike
fields.description: The bike as the form describes it.

fields.name: job_type
fields.description: brakes, steering, gears, wheels, punctures or other.

fields.name: reason
fields.description: One sentence, quoting the customer's description.

fields.name: flag
fields.description: 'ask the workshop' when the sources do not settle the row, otherwise empty.

cites: [A:A01 "A slip with no fault description is refused as 'ask the customer'."]

rules.statement: A promised date is never earlier than the queue's bench time allows.
cites: [A:A01 "Q01 a promised date is never earlier than the queue's bench time allows (blocker)."]

rules.statement: A brake or steering job goes ahead of every other job.
cites: [A:A01 "Q02 a brake or steering job goes ahead of every other job (major)."]

rules.statement: Every row quotes the customer's description from the form.
cites: [A:A01 "Q03 every row quotes the customer's description from the form (major)."]

rules.statement: Bench minutes come from the bench-time table, never a guess.
cites: [A:A01 "Q04 bench minutes come from the bench-time table, never a guess"]

bad.why: The promised date is earlier than the bench time allows: two weekends of work are ahead of it.
A brake job is behind another kind of job.

risk.notes: A queue can be reordered before the work starts, but a missed promise has already let a customer down. Customers are affected.
cites: [A:A01 "Partly reversible"]
[A:A02 "About sixty customers a month and twelve repair volunteers."]
[A:A01 "Reads the typed drop-off forms."]

gates.decision: Approve or reject the repair queue.
cites: [A:A01 "I sign off the queue before it goes on the whiteboard."]

open_questions.question: Should bikes left over from last Saturday go first?
Do children's bikes get their own bench-time line?

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Every brake and steering job first on four made-up Saturdays.
cites: [A:A02 "It must order every brake and steering job first on four made-up Saturdays."]
